append.detail: 2026-10-26 integration probe repair: the city-search component adopted buttonClasses through the Frequency action sweep. The runtime guard now loads actual components/ui/button.tsx and its actual dependency-free cn helper instead of rejecting that dependency or supplying a no-op stub. Existing stale-response, loading-clear, rejection recovery, coordinate rounding and filter-preservation assertions remain. It also renders/clears an active Near action and verifies actual kit geometry. Isolated child-process mutation controls still fail on stale publication and on a real cn helper that drops geometry. No application/geocoding/network behavior changed.
